name: harness
description: Plan and execute feature queues when isolation, dependencies or resumption warrant them; ordinary questions, read-only reviews and small local fixes use the direct path.

interface.shortDescription: Plan only as much as the task needs
interface.longDescription: Proportionate planning and isolated execution with explicit scope, recoverable work, and evidence-based verification.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use a feature queue only when isolation, dependencies or resumption justify it. Reuse approved plans and authorization, read only relevant context, and verify the requested outcome.
